title: Custom GUI PLUS
description: This mod allows you to fully customize the game's interface.
body:
## 🖥️ Custom GUI PLUS ▫️ This mod allows you to fully customize the game's **interface**!
▪️ It displays your armor status, coordinates, keystrokes etc.
🔸 You can easily configure modules to get the best gaming experience.
## 💯 Compatibility ❤️ It's compatible with all mods like Apple Skin, Shulker Box Tooltip, Better F3, etc.. ## ✨ Features ▫️ **Modular HUD System** – Enable or disable each element independently
▪️ **Armor Status Display** – Clean and minimal armor durability preview
▫️ **FPS Counter** – Real-time performance tracking
▪️ **Coordinates Display** – Always know your exact position
▫️ **Keystrokes Module** – Visualize your movement keys (WASD, LMB, RMB)
▪️ **Sprint Status** – See when sprint is active
▫️ **Custom Crosshair** – Minimal styled crosshair overlay
▪️ **Compass Module** – Always know your direction
▫️ **Time Display** – In-game time preview
And much more!
**An example of this mod's skills** ![You can do this with this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a6a7a31678d01a379629aa4ea32540bf92b7f40.png)
⚠️ This is the first version of the mod, I would be grateful if you could report any bugs on my discord
